images.title: Degrees in key angles
images.purpose: A right angle measures 90 degrees and a straight angle measures 180 degrees.
images.composition: Two angles side by side, the right angle on the left and the straight angle on the right, with space between.
images.exact_structure: Left: a right angle of exactly 90 degrees in teal #0072B2 with a small square corner mark. Right: a straight angle (one horizontal line with the vertex at its middle and the upper half shaded) in amber #E69F00. Arms of equal length, vertex dots. Exactly 2 angles, 2 degree labels.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any of the following: a full turn drawn
images.takeaway: A right angle is 90° and a straight angle is 180°.
images.description: A teal right angle labelled 90 degrees and an amber straight angle labelled 180 degrees.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say each angle name and its degree measure aloud.

image_decisions.why: The two key degree measures are one clean picture of two angles with their numbers.
